sentences.zh: 推天正冬至：置距所求積年，以歲周乘之，為氣積分；

translations.literal: To seek the winter solstice of heaven's first month: set the accumulated years from the epoch to the year sought, multiply by the year circuit to obtain qi accumulation parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil-year winter solstice: set the accumulated years from the epoch to the year sought, multiply by the tropical year circuit for the qi accumulation;

sentences.zh: 滿旬周去之，不盡，以統法約之為大餘，不滿為小餘。

translations.literal: remove all that fill the ten-day circuit; what does not exhaust, reduce by the era divisor for the greater remainder, what does not fill is the lesser remainder.
translations.idiomatic: divide out the ten-day circuit; the remainder, reduced by the era divisor, yields the greater remainder, and what is left is the lesser remainder.

sentences.zh: 其大餘命甲子，算外，即所求年天正冬至日辰及餘。

translations.literal: With the greater remainder count from jiazi, outside the count, that is the day, double-hour, and remainder of the winter solstice of heaven's first month for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count the greater remainder from jiazi; the day after the count gives the winter solstice date, double-hour, and remainder for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求次氣：置天正冬至大、小餘，以氣策及餘秒累加之，秒盈秒法從小餘一，小餘盈統法從大餘一，大余盈紀法去之。

translations.literal: To seek the next qi: set the greater and lesser remainders of the winter solstice of heaven's first month, add the qi divisor and remainder-seconds cumulatively; when seconds fill the second divisor carry one to the lesser remainder, when the lesser remainder fills the era divisor carry one to the greater remainder, when the greater remainder fills the cycle method remove it.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next solar term: set the winter solstice greater and lesser remainders and add the qi divisor cumulatively; carry seconds into the lesser remainder, the lesser remainder into the greater, and remove full sexagenary cycles from the greater remainder.

sentences.zh: 命甲子，算外，即各得次氣日辰及餘秒。

translations.literal: Count from jiazi, outside the count, and each yields the day, double-hour, and remainder-seconds of the next qi.
translations.idiomatic: Count from jiazi; the day after the count gives each successive solar term's date, double-hour, and remainder.

sentences.zh: 推天正經朔：置天正冬至氣積分，以朔實去之，不盡為閏餘；

translations.literal: To seek the mean new moon of heaven's first month: set the qi accumulation parts of the winter solstice of heaven's first month, remove the new-moon dividend; what does not exhaust is the intercalation remainder;
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil-year mean new moon: set the winter solstice qi accumulation and divide by the synodic month dividend; the remainder is the intercalation remainder;

sentences.zh: 以減天正冬至氣積分，餘為天正十一月經朔加時積分；

translations.literal: subtract it from the qi accumulation parts of the winter solstice of heaven's first month; the remainder is the time-of-day accumulation parts for the mean new moon of the eleventh month of heaven's first month;
translations.idiomatic: subtract this from the winter solstice qi accumulation; the remainder is the time-of-day accumulation for the eleventh month's mean new moon;

sentences.zh: 滿旬周去之，不盡，以統法約之為大餘，不滿為小餘。

translations.literal: remove all that fill the ten-day circuit; what does not exhaust, reduce by the era divisor for the greater remainder, what does not fill is the lesser remainder.
translations.idiomatic: divide out the ten-day circuit; the remainder, reduced by the era divisor, yields the greater remainder, and what is left is the lesser remainder.

sentences.zh: 其大餘命甲子，算外，即所求年天正十一月經朔日辰及餘。

translations.literal: With the greater remainder count from jiazi, outside the count, that is the day, double-hour, and remainder of the mean new moon of the eleventh month of heaven's first month for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count the greater remainder from jiazi; the day after the count gives the eleventh month's mean new moon date, double-hour, and remainder for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求弦望及次朔經日：置天正十一月經朔大、小餘，以弦策累加之，去命如前，即各得弦、望及次朔經日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek the quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive mean-new-moon days: set the greater and lesser remainders of the mean new moon of the eleventh month of heaven's first month, add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively, count and remove as before, and each yields the mean day and remainder-seconds of the quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive new moons.
translations.idiomatic: To find quarter, full, and successive mean new moons: set the eleventh-month mean new moon remainders, add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively, and count as before to obtain each mean date and remainder.

sentences.zh: 求沒日：置有沒之氣小餘，以三百六十乘之，其秒進一位，從之，用減歲周，余滿歲餘除之為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: To seek the extinction day: set the lesser remainder of the qi that has extinction, multiply it by 360, advance its seconds one place and follow with them, use this to subtract from the year circuit; the remainder, when the year remainder divides it fully, is the day, what does not fill is the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the extinction day: set the lesser remainder of the qi subject to extinction, multiply by 360 with seconds carried one place, subtract from the tropical year circuit, and divide the remainder by the year remainder for the day count.

sentences.zh: 其日，命其氣初日日辰，算外，即為其氣沒日日辰。

translations.literal: For that day, count from the day and double-hour of that qi's beginning, outside the count, and that is the day and double-hour of that qi's extinction day.
translations.idiomatic: Count that many days from the qi's opening date; the day after the count is the extinction day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 凡氣小餘在沒限以上者，為有沒之氣。

translations.literal: Whenever a qi's lesser remainder is at the extinction limit or above, it is a qi that has extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Any qi whose lesser remainder reaches the extinction limit or above is subject to extinction.

sentences.zh: 求滅日：置有滅之朔小餘，以三十乘之，滿朔虛分除之為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: To seek the annihilation day: set the lesser remainder of the new moon that has annihilation, multiply it by 30; when it fills the new-moon void parts, divide to obtain the day, what does not fill is the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the annihilation day: set the lesser remainder of the affected new moon, multiply by 30, and divide by the new-moon void for the day count.

sentences.zh: 其日命其月經朔初日日辰，算外，即為其月滅日日辰。

translations.literal: For that day count from the day and double-hour of that month's mean-new-moon beginning, outside the count, and that is the day and double-hour of that month's annihilation day.
translations.idiomatic: Count from that month's mean new moon opening date; the day after the count is the annihilation day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 凡經朔小餘不滿朔虛分者，為有滅之朔。

translations.literal: Whenever a mean new moon's lesser remainder does not fill the new-moon void parts, it is a new moon that has annihilation.
translations.idiomatic: Any mean new moon whose lesser remainder falls short of the new-moon void is subject to annihilation.

sentences.zh: 推七十二候：各因中節大、小餘命之，為初候；

translations.literal: To seek the seventy-two pentads: for each, take the greater and lesser remainders of the mid-term and count from them for the first pentad;
translations.idiomatic: To find the seventy-two climatic pentads: for each mid-term, count from its greater and lesser remainders for the first pentad;

sentences.zh: 以候策加之，為次候；

translations.literal: add the pentad divisor to obtain the second pentad;
translations.idiomatic: add the pentad divisor for the second pentad;

sentences.zh: 又加之，為末候。

translations.literal: add again for the last pentad.
translations.idiomatic: add again for the third pentad.

sentences.zh: 求六十四卦：各因中氣大、小餘命之，為初卦用事日；

translations.literal: To seek the sixty-four hexagrams: for each, take the greater and lesser remainders of the mid-qi and count from them for the day when the first hexagram takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: To find the sixty-four hexagrams: for each mid-qi, count from its remainders for the first hexagram's effective day;

sentences.zh: 以卦策加之，為中卦用事日；

translations.literal: add the hexagram divisor for the day when the middle hexagram takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: add the hexagram divisor for the middle hexagram's effective day;

sentences.zh: 又加之，得終卦用事日。

translations.literal: add again to obtain the day when the final hexagram takes effect.
translations.idiomatic: add again for the final hexagram's effective day.

sentences.zh: 以土王策加諸侯內卦，得十有二節之初外卦用事日；

translations.literal: Add the earth-kingship divisor to the feudal-lord inner hexagram to obtain the day when the outer hexagram of the twelve terms' beginning takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: Add the earth-kingship divisor to the feudal lord's inner hexagram for the outer hexagram's effective day at each of the twelve terms;

sentences.zh: 又加之，得大夫卦用事日；

translations.literal: add again to obtain the day when the grandee hexagram takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: add again for the grandee hexagram's effective day;

sentences.zh: 復以卦策加之，得卿卦用事日。

translations.literal: again add the hexagram divisor to obtain the day when the minister hexagram takes effect.
translations.idiomatic: add the hexagram divisor again for the minister hexagram's effective day.

sentences.zh: 推五行用事：各因四立之節大、小餘命之，即春木、夏火、秋金、冬水首用事日；

translations.literal: To seek the five phases' taking effect: for each, take the greater and lesser remainders of the four establishment terms and count from them, and these are the first days when spring wood, summer fire, autumn metal, and winter water take effect;
translations.idiomatic: To find when the five phases take effect: count from the four establishment terms' remainders for the opening days of spring wood, summer fire, autumn metal, and winter water;

sentences.zh: 以土王策減四季中氣大、小餘，命甲子，算外，為其月土始用事日。

translations.literal: Subtract the earth-kingship divisor from the greater and lesser remainders of the four seasons' mid-qi, count from jiazi, outside the count, and that is the day when earth first takes effect in that month.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the earth-kingship divisor from each season's mid-qi remainders, count from jiazi, and the day after the count is that month's first earth-kingship day.

sentences.zh: 求中氣去經朔：置天正冬至閏餘，以月閏累加之，滿統法約之為日，不盡為餘，即各得每月中氣去經朔日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek the mid-qi's distance from the mean new moon: set the intercalation remainder of the winter solstice of heaven's first month, add the monthly intercalation cumulatively; when full reduce by the era divisor for days, what does not exhaust is the remainder, and each month yields the day and remainder-seconds by which the mid-qi stands from the mean new moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find each mid-qi's offset from the mean new moon: set the winter solstice intercalation remainder, add the monthly intercalation cumulatively, reduce by the era divisor for days, and obtain each month's mid-qi offset in days and seconds.

sentences.zh: 其閏余滿閏限者，為月內有閏也；

translations.literal: When its intercalation remainder fills the intercalation limit, the month has intercalation within it;
translations.idiomatic: When the intercalation remainder reaches the intercalation limit, the month contains an intercalary day;

sentences.zh: 仍定其朔內無中氣者為閏月。

translations.literal: still fix as intercalary month the one whose new-moon period has no mid-qi within it.
translations.idiomatic: and designate as an intercalary month any month whose lunation contains no mid-qi.

sentences.zh: 求卦候去經朔：以卦、候策累加減中氣，去經朔日及餘，中氣前，減；

translations.literal: To seek the hexagram and pentad's distance from the mean new moon: with the hexagram and pentad divisors add and subtract cumulatively from the mid-qi for the day and remainder from the mean new moon; before the mid-qi, subtract;
translations.idiomatic: To find hexagram and pentad offsets from the mean new moon: cumulatively add or subtract the hexagram and pentad divisors from the mid-qi; subtract before the mid-qi;

sentences.zh: 中氣後，加。

translations.literal: after the mid-qi, add.
translations.idiomatic: add after the mid-qi.

sentences.zh: 即各得卦、候去經朔日及餘秒。

translations.literal: and each yields the day and remainder-seconds by which the hexagram and pentad stand from the mean new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Thus obtaining each hexagram and pentad's offset from the mean new moon in days and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求發斂加時：倍所求小餘，以辰法除之為辰數，不滿，五因之，滿刻法為刻，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: To seek the time-of-day for issuing and gathering: double the lesser remainder sought, divide by the double-hour divisor for the double-hour count; what does not fill, multiply by five; when it fills the quarter-divisor that is quarters, what does not fill is the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the time-of-day: double the lesser remainder, divide by the double-hour divisor for the double-hour count, multiply the remainder by five, and divide by the quarter divisor for quarters.

sentences.zh: 其辰數命子正，算外，即各得所求加時辰、刻及分。

translations.literal: With the double-hour count begin at zi as the standard hour, outside the count, and each yields the double-hour, quarter, and parts of the time sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count the double-hours from midnight zi; the count gives each sought time's double-hour, quarter, and fractional parts.

translations.literal: Limit days from the beginning of surplus after winter solstice to the end of contraction after summer solstice: 88, remainder 10,958.

sentences.zh: 夏至後縮初冬至後盈末限日：九十三、餘八千五百五十二。

translations.literal: Limit days from the beginning of contraction after summer solstice to the end of surplus after winter solstice: 93, remainder 8,552.
translations.idiomatic: Limit from post-summer-solstice contraction opening to post-winter-solstice surplus closing: 93 days, remainder 8,552

sentences.zh: 求每日盈縮分：置入二至後全日，各在初限已下為初限；

translations.literal: To seek each day's surplus and contraction parts: set the full days after a solstice; each that is at the initial limit or below is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's equation parts: set the full days after a solstice; days within the opening limit count as the opening limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減二至限，餘為末限。

translations.literal: what is above, subtract from the solstice limit, and the remainder is the closing limit.
translations.idiomatic: days above that, subtract from the solstice limit for the closing limit.

sentences.zh: 列初、末限日及分於上，倍初、末限日及約分於下，相減相乘。

translations.literal: Set out the opening and closing limit days and parts above, double the opening and closing limit days and reduced parts below, subtract and multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Place the opening and closing limit days and parts above, double them below, and subtract and multiply.

sentences.zh: 求盈縮分者，在盈初、縮末，以三千二百九十四除之。

translations.literal: For those seeking surplus-contraction parts, in the opening of surplus and closing of contraction, divide by 3,294.
translations.idiomatic: For the equation parts, in the surplus opening and contraction closing, divide by 3,294.

sentences.zh: 在盈末、縮初，以三千六百五十九除之，皆為度，不滿，退除為分秒。

translations.literal: In the closing of surplus and opening of contraction, divide by 3,659; all become degrees, and what does not fill, step back and divide for parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: In the surplus closing and contraction opening, divide by 3,659; reduce to degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求朏朒積者，各退二位，在盈初縮末，以三百六十六而一；

translations.literal: For those seeking waxing-waning accumulation, each steps back two places; in the opening of surplus and closing of contraction, divide by 366;
translations.idiomatic: For the phase accumulation, shift two places; in the surplus opening and contraction closing, divide by 366;

sentences.zh: 在盈末縮初，以四百七而一，各得所求。

translations.literal: in the closing of surplus and opening of contraction, divide by 407, and each obtains what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: in the surplus closing and contraction opening, divide by 407, to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 以盈縮相減，餘為升降分；

translations.literal: Subtract surplus from contraction; the remainder is the ascending-descending parts;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two equation values; the remainder is the ascension-descension parts;

sentences.zh: 盈初縮末為升，縮初盈末為降。

translations.literal: opening of surplus and closing of contraction are ascension, opening of contraction and closing of surplus are descension.
translations.idiomatic: surplus opening and contraction closing mean ascension; contraction opening and surplus closing mean descension.

sentences.zh: 以朏朒積相減，餘為損益率。

translations.literal: Subtract the waxing-waning accumulations; the remainder is the decrease-increase rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the phase accumulations; the remainder is the correction rate.

sentences.zh: 在初為益，在末為損。

translations.literal: In the opening it is increase, in the closing it is decrease.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening it increases; at the closing it decreases.

translations.literal: To seek mean new moon, quarter, and full moon entry into the surplus-contraction limit: set the intercalary day and remainder of heaven's first month, subtract the closing-of-contraction limit day and remainder, for the mean new moon of the eleventh month of heaven's first month's entry into the closing-of-contraction limit day and remainder;
translations.idiomatic: To find mean conjunction and quarter-moon entry into the equation limit: set the civil-year intercalary day and remainder, subtract the contraction-closing limit, for the eleventh month's mean new moon entry;

sentences.zh: 以弦策累加之，滿盈縮限日去之，即各得弦望及次朔入盈縮限日及餘秒。

translations.literal: add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively, remove all that fill the surplus-contraction limit days, and each yields the quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive new moons' entry into the surplus-contraction limit day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively, remove full equation limits, and obtain each quarter, full, and new moon's entry day and remainder.

sentences.zh: 求經朔弦望朏朒定數：各置所入盈縮限日小餘，以其日下損益率乘之，如統法而一，所得，損益其下朏朒積為定數。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed numbers of waxing-waning for mean new moon, quarter, and full moon: for each set the lesser remainder of the day of entry into the surplus-contraction limit, multiply it by the decrease-increase rate below that day, as one part of the era divisor, and what is obtained decreases or increases the waxing-waning accumulation below it for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true phase numbers for mean conjunctions and quarters: set each entry day's lesser remainder, multiply by that day's correction rate, divide by the era divisor, and apply to the phase accumulation below for the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 求定氣：冬夏二至以常氣為定氣。

translations.literal: To seek fixed qi: the winter and summer solstices take the regular qi as fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find true solar terms: the winter and summer solstices use the mean terms as true terms.

sentences.zh: 自後，以其氣限日下盈縮分盈加縮減常氣約餘，即為所求之氣定日及分秒。

translations.literal: Thereafter, with the surplus-contraction parts below that qi's limit day, add for surplus and subtract for contraction from the regular qi's reduced remainder, and that is the fixed day and parts-seconds of the qi sought.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, add surplus or subtract contraction from each term's mean remainder using the equation parts below its limit day to obtain the true term's date and seconds.

sentences.zh: 自《大衍曆》依渾儀測為定，用紘帶天中，儀極攸憑，以格黃道。

translations.literal: From the Dayan Calendar onward they were fixed by measurement with the armillary sphere, using the girdle cord at heaven's center and relying on the instrument's pole to mark out the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Dayan Calendar they were fixed by armillary-sphere measurement, using the celestial girdle at heaven's center and the instrument's pole to lay out the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 推天正冬至加時赤道日度：以歲差乘所求積年，滿周天分去之，不盡，用減周天分，餘以統法除之為度，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: To seek the equatorial solar degree at the time of the winter solstice of heaven's first month: multiply the accumulated years sought by the annual difference, remove all that fill the circumference parts; what does not exhaust, use to subtract from the circumference parts; the remainder, when the era divisor divides it fully, is degrees, what does not fill is the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the equatorial solar degree at the civil-year winter solstice: multiply the years sought by precession, divide out the circumference parts, subtract the remainder from the circumference parts, and reduce the result by the era divisor for degrees and remainder.

sentences.zh: 命起赤道虛宿四度外去之，至不滿宿，即為所求年天正冬至加時赤道日度及餘秒。

translations.literal: Count from four degrees outside the equatorial Void lodge and remove; when it no longer fills a lodge, that is the equatorial solar degree and remainder-seconds at the time of the winter solstice of heaven's first month for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count from four degrees outside equatorial Void and remove lodge spans; the remainder gives the winter solstice equatorial solar degree and seconds for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求夏至赤道日度：置天正冬至加時赤道日度，以二至限及余加之，滿赤道宿次去之，即得夏至加時赤道日度及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek the summer solstice equatorial solar degree: set the equatorial solar degree at the time of the winter solstice of heaven's first month, add the solstice limit and remainder; when full remove equatorial lodge spans, and the summer solstice equatorial solar degree and remainder-seconds are obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the summer solstice equatorial solar degree: set the winter solstice equatorial degree, add the solstice limit and remainder, remove full lodge spans, and obtain the summer solstice equatorial degree and seconds.

sentences.zh: 因求後昏後夜半赤道日度者，以二至小餘減統法，餘以加二至赤道日度之餘，即二至初日昏後夜半赤道日度，以每日累加一度，去命如前，各得所求。

translations.literal: For those who thereby seek the equatorial solar degree after dusk and at midnight thereafter, subtract the solstice lesser remainder from the era divisor, add the remainder to the remainder of the solstice equatorial solar degree, and that is the equatorial solar degree after dusk and at midnight on the solstice's first day; add one degree cumulatively each day and count and remove as before, and each sought value is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find post-dusk and midnight equatorial degrees thereafter: subtract the solstice lesser remainder from the era divisor, add the remainder to the solstice equatorial remainder for the first day's post-dusk and midnight degree, add one degree daily, and count as before for each value sought.

sentences.zh: 求二十八宿赤道積度：置二至加時日躔赤道全度，以二至加時赤道日度及約分減之，餘為距後度。

translations.literal: To seek the accumulated equatorial degrees of the twenty-eight lodges: set the full equatorial degree of the sun's motion at the solstice with time-of-day, subtract the equatorial solar degree and reduced parts at the solstice with time-of-day; the remainder is the degrees after the solstice.
translations.idiomatic: To find the twenty-eight lodges' accumulated equatorial degrees: set the full equatorial solar motion at the solstice with time-of-day, subtract the solstice equatorial degree and reduced parts; the remainder is the post-solstice offset.

sentences.zh: 以赤道宿次累加之，即得二十八宿赤道積度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add the equatorial lodge spans cumulatively, and the accumulated equatorial degrees and parts-seconds of the twenty-eight lodges are obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Add equatorial lodge spans cumulatively to obtain each lodge's accumulated equatorial degrees and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求二十八宿赤道積度入初末限：各置赤道積度及分秒，滿象限九十一度三十一分、秒九即去之，若在四十五度六十五分、秒五十四半已下為初限；

translations.literal: To seek the twenty-eight lodges' accumulated equatorial degrees' entry into opening and closing limits: for each set the accumulated equatorial degrees and parts-seconds; when they fill the image limit of 91 degrees 31 parts and 9 seconds, remove it; if at 45 degrees 65 parts and 54 and a half seconds or below, it is the opening limit;
translations.idiomatic: To find entry into opening and closing limits: set each lodge's accumulated equatorial degrees; remove full image limits of 91°31′9″; degrees at or below 45°65′54.5″ count as the opening limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減象限，餘為末限。

translations.literal: what is above, subtract from the image limit, and the remainder is the closing limit.
translations.idiomatic: degrees above that, subtract from the image limit for the closing limit.

sentences.zh: 求二十八宿黃道度：各置赤道宿入初、末限度及分，三之，為限分。

translations.literal: To seek the ecliptic degrees of the twenty-eight lodges: for each set the lodge's entry into opening and closing limit degrees and parts, treble them for limit parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the twenty-eight lodges' ecliptic degrees: set each lodge's opening or closing limit degrees and parts and treble them for limit parts.

sentences.zh: 用減四百，餘以限分乘之，一萬二千而一為度，命曰黃赤道差。

translations.literal: Subtract from 400; multiply the remainder by the limit parts; divide by 12,000 for degrees, and name it the yellow-red difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 400, multiply by the limit parts, divide by 12,000 for degrees, and call this the ecliptic-equator difference.

sentences.zh: 至後以減、分後以加赤道宿積度，為黃道積度；

translations.literal: after the solstice subtract, after the equinox add to the accumulated equatorial lodge degrees for the accumulated ecliptic degrees;
translations.idiomatic: After the solstice subtract and after the equinox add to the equatorial accumulation for the ecliptic accumulation;

sentences.zh: 以前宿黃道積度減之，余為二十八宿黃道度及分。

translations.literal: subtract the preceding lodge's accumulated ecliptic degrees; the remainder is that lodge's ecliptic degrees and parts among the twenty-eight lodges.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the preceding lodge's ecliptic accumulation; the remainder is that lodge's ecliptic degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 其分就近約為太、半、少，若二至之宿不足減者，即加二至限，然後減之，餘依術算。

translations.literal: Its parts are reduced nearby to great, half, and small; if a solstice lodge is insufficient for subtraction, add the solstice limit and then subtract; the remainder follows the procedure's calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce fractional parts to great, half, or small; if a solstice lodge cannot be subtracted, add the solstice limit first, then subtract, and proceed by the formula.

translations.idiomatic: To project backward or verify forward, one must rely on precession: for each degree of shift, derive the change by the calendar before stepping the seven luminaries to know their positions.

sentences.zh: 求天正冬至加時黃道日度：置天正冬至加時赤道日度及約分，三之，為限分；

translations.literal: To seek the ecliptic solar degree at the time of the winter solstice of heaven's first month: set the equatorial solar degree and reduced parts at that time, treble them for limit parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic solar degree at the civil-year winter solstice: set the equatorial solar degree and reduced parts and treble them for limit parts;

sentences.zh: 用減四百，餘以限分乘之，一萬二千而一為度，命曰黃赤道差；

translations.literal: subtract from 400; multiply the remainder by the limit parts; divide by 12,000 for degrees and name it the yellow-red difference;

sentences.zh: 用減天正冬至加時赤道日度及分，即為所求年天正冬至加時黃道日度及分。

translations.literal: use it to subtract from the equatorial solar degree and parts at the winter solstice of heaven's first month with time-of-day, and that is the ecliptic solar degree and parts at that time for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: subtract this from the winter solstice equatorial degree and parts to obtain the sought year's winter solstice ecliptic degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 夏至日度，准此求之。

translations.literal: The summer solstice solar degree is sought by the same standard.
translations.idiomatic: Find the summer solstice solar degree by the same method.

sentences.zh: 求二至初日晨前夜半黃道日度：置一萬分，以其日升降分升加降減之，以乘二至小餘，如統法而一，所得，以減二至加時黃道日度，餘為二至初日晨前夜半黃道日度及分。

translations.literal: To seek the ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight on the solstice's first day: set 10,000 parts, with that day's ascending-descending parts add for ascension and subtract for descension, multiply by the solstice lesser remainder, as one part of the era divisor; what is obtained subtracts from the solstice ecliptic solar degree with time-of-day; the remainder is the ecliptic solar degree and parts before dawn and at midnight on the solstice's first day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic degree before dawn and at midnight on a solstice's first day: set 10,000 parts, apply that day's ascension-descension parts, multiply by the solstice lesser remainder and divide by the era divisor, subtract from the solstice ecliptic degree, and the remainder is the predawn and midnight ecliptic degree.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨前夜半黃道日度：置二至初日晨前夜半黃道日度及分，每日加一度，百約其日下升降分，升加降減之，滿黃道宿次去之，即各得二至後每日晨前夜半黃道日度及分。

translations.literal: To seek each day's ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight: set the ecliptic solar degree and parts before dawn and at midnight on the solstice's first day, add one degree daily, reduce the ascending-descending parts below that day by a hundred, add for ascension and subtract for descension, when full remove ecliptic lodge spans, and each yields the ecliptic solar degree and parts before dawn and at midnight for each day after the solstice.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's predawn and midnight ecliptic degree: set the solstice first-day value, add one degree daily with ascension added or descension subtracted per the day's rate, remove full ecliptic lodge spans, and obtain each post-solstice predawn and midnight degree.

sentences.zh: 求太陽過宮日時刻：置黃道過宮宿度，以其日晨前夜半黃道宿度及分減之，餘以統法乘之，如其太陽行分而一，為加時小餘；

translations.literal: To seek the day, time, and quarter when the sun passes a lodge: set the ecliptic lodge degree of the sun's passage, subtract that day's ecliptic lodge degree and parts before dawn and at midnight; multiply the remainder by the era divisor, divide by the sun's motion parts for one, for the time-of-day lesser remainder;
translations.idiomatic: To find when the sun passes a lodge: set the passage lodge degree, subtract that day's predawn and midnight ecliptic lodge degree, multiply by the era divisor and divide by the sun's daily motion for the time-of-day lesser remainder;

sentences.zh: 如發斂求之，即得太陽過宮日、時、刻及分。

translations.literal: seek it as in issuing and gathering, and the day, time, quarter, and parts of the sun's lodge passage are obtained.
translations.idiomatic: derive the time by the issuing-and-gathering procedure to obtain the sun's lodge-passage day, time, quarter, and parts.

sentences.zh: 黃道過宮太史局吳澤等補治有此一段，開封進士吳時舉、國學進士程憙、常州百姓張文進本並無之。

translations.literal: For the sun's ecliptic lodge passage, Wu Ze and others of the Astronomical Bureau supplemented and corrected this section; the Kaifeng presented scholar Wu Shiju, the National University presented scholar Cheng Xi, and the Changzhou commoner Zhang Wenjin versions all lack it.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic lodge-passage section was supplemented and corrected by Wu Ze and others of the Astronomical Bureau; the versions of Wu Shiju, Presented Scholar of Kaifeng, Cheng Xi, Presented Scholar of the National University, and Zhang Wenjin, commoner of Changzhou, all lack it.
