sentences.zh: 求天正十一月經朔加時入轉：置天正十一月經朔加時積分，以轉周分秒去之，不盡，以統法約之為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: To seek entry into rotation at the added time of the eleventh month's mean new moon of heaven's standard: set the accumulated parts for the eleventh month's mean new moon at added time of heaven's standard, remove rotation circuit parts and seconds; what does not exhaust, reduce by the era divisor for days, what does not fill is remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find entry into rotation at the civil-year eleventh month's mean-new-moon time of occurrence: set the accumulated parts for that mean new moon, cast out rotation-circuit parts and seconds; reduce the remainder by the era divisor for days, with the unfilled portion as remainder.

sentences.zh: 命日，算外，即得所求年天正十一月經朔加時入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Name the days; outside the count, and you obtain the sought year's eleventh-month mean new moon added-time entry-into-rotation day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Count the days from the stem; outside the count yields the sought year's eleventh-month mean-new-moon time-of-occurrence entry into rotation, with its day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 若以朔差日及餘秒加之，滿轉周日及餘秒去之，即次朔加時入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: If the new-moon difference day and remainder-seconds are added, and it fills rotation circuit days and remainder-seconds, remove them—that is the next new moon's added-time entry into rotation day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add the new-moon difference day and remainder-seconds; cast out full rotation-circuit days and remainder-seconds to obtain the next new moon's time-of-occurrence entry into rotation.

sentences.zh: 各以其月經朔小餘減之，餘為其月經朔夜半入轉。

translations.literal: For each, subtract its month's mean new moon lesser remainder; the remainder is that month's mean new moon midnight entry into rotation.
translations.idiomatic: For each month subtract that month's mean-new-moon minor remainder; the remainder is that month's mean-new-moon midnight entry into rotation.

sentences.zh: 求弦望入轉：因天正十一月經朔加時入轉日及餘秒，以弦策累加之，去命如前，即得弦、望入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek quarter and full moon entry into rotation: from the eleventh month's mean new moon added-time entry into rotation day and remainder-seconds, add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively; cast out and name as before to obtain quarter and full moon entry-into-rotation days and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find quarter- and full-moon entry into rotation: from the eleventh month's mean-new-moon entry, add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively; cast out and name as before for each quarter and full moon.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望入轉朏朒定數：置入轉餘，乘其日算外損益率，如統法而一，所得，以損益其下朏朒積為定數。

translations.literal: To seek the waxing-waning fixed numbers for mean new moon, quarter, and full moon entry into rotation: set the entry-into-rotation remainder, multiply by that day's decrease-increase rate beyond the count, as one part of the era divisor; what is obtained decreases or increases the waxing-waning accumulation below for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true waxing-waning numbers for mean conjunction and quarters entering rotation: set the rotation remainder, multiply by that day's correction rate beyond the count, divide by the era divisor, and apply to the phase accumulation below.

sentences.zh: 其在四七日下余如初數已下，初率乘之，初數而一，以損益其下朏朒積為定數。

translations.literal: When within the four-seven-day range the remainder is at or below the initial count, multiply by the initial rate, as one part of the initial count, and decrease or increase the waxing-waning accumulation below for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth and seventh days, if the remainder is at or below the initial count, multiply by the initial rate and divide by the initial count, then adjust the phase accumulation below.

sentences.zh: 若初數已上者，以初數減之，餘乘末率，末數而一，用減初率，餘加其日下朏朒積為定數。

translations.literal: If at or above the initial count, subtract the initial count; multiply the remainder by the final rate, as one part of the final count; use this to subtract from the initial rate; add the remainder to that day's waxing-waning accumulation for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: If at or above the initial count, subtract the initial count; multiply the remainder by the final rate and divide by the final count; subtract from the initial rate and add the remainder to that day's phase accumulation.

sentences.zh: 其十四日下余若在初數已上者，初數減之，餘乘末率，末數而一，便為朏定數。

translations.literal: If on the fourteenth day the remainder is at or above the initial count, subtract the initial count; multiply the remainder by the final rate, as one part of the final count—that is directly the waxing fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day, if the remainder is at or above the initial count, subtract the initial count; multiply the remainder by the final rate and divide by the final count—that is the waxing fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望定日、各以入限、入轉朏朒定數，朏減朒加經朔、弦、望小余，滿若不足，進退大餘，命甲子，算外。

translations.literal: To seek fixed days for mean new moon, quarter, and full moon: for each apply the entry-limit and entry-into-rotation waxing-waning fixed numbers—subtract waxing and add waning from the mean new moon, quarter, and full moon lesser remainders; on fullness or shortfall advance or retreat the greater remainder; name from jiazi, outside the count.
translations.idiomatic: To find true new-moon, quarter, and full-moon days: apply the equation-limit and rotation waxing-waning fixed numbers—subtract waxing and add waning from each mean minor remainder; on fullness or shortfall advance or retreat the major remainder and name from jiazi.

sentences.zh: 各得定日及餘。

translations.literal: Each yields the fixed day and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Each yields the true day and remainder.

sentences.zh: 若定朔幹名與後朔幹名同者月大，不同者月小，其月內無中氣者為閏月。

translations.literal: If the fixed new moon stem-name matches the following new moon's stem-name, the month is long; if they differ, the month is short; a month with no mid-qi within it is intercalary.
translations.idiomatic: If the true new moon's stem matches the next new moon's stem, the month is long; if they differ, it is short; a month with no mid-term inside it is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 凡注曆，觀定朔小余，秋分後在統法四分之三已上者，進一日；

translations.literal: When annotating the calendar, observe the fixed new moon lesser remainder: after the autumn equinox, if it reaches three-quarters of the era divisor or above, advance one day;
translations.idiomatic: When publishing the calendar, inspect the true-new-moon minor remainder: after the autumn equinox, if it reaches three-quarters of the era divisor or more, advance one day.

sentences.zh: 若春分後定朔晨昏差如春分之日者，三約之，用減四分之三；

translations.literal: If after the spring equinox the fixed new moon dawn-dusk difference equals that of the spring equinox day, divide by three and subtract from three-quarters;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, if the true new moon's dawn-dusk difference equals that of the equinox day, divide by three and subtract from three-quarters of the era divisor.

sentences.zh: 定朔小餘在此數已上者，亦進一日；

translations.literal: If the fixed new moon lesser remainder reaches this number or above, advance one day as well;
translations.idiomatic: If the true-new-moon minor remainder reaches this threshold or above, advance one day as well.

sentences.zh: 或當交虧初在日入已前者，其朔不進。

translations.literal: Or if when a crossing occurs first contact comes before sunset, do not advance the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Or if at a crossing the eclipse begins before sunset, do not advance the new moon.

sentences.zh: 弦、望定小餘不滿日出分者，退一日；

translations.literal: For quarter and full moon, if the fixed lesser remainder falls short of the sunrise fraction, retreat one day;
translations.idiomatic: For quarters and full moon, if the true minor remainder falls short of the sunrise fraction, retreat one day.

sentences.zh: 望若有交，虧初在日出分已前者，其定望小余雖滿日出分，亦退一日。

translations.literal: At full moon, if there is a crossing and first contact comes before the sunrise fraction, even if the fixed full moon lesser remainder fills the sunrise fraction, still retreat one day.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon, if there is a crossing and the eclipse begins before the sunrise fraction, retreat one day even when the true full-moon minor remainder exceeds the sunrise fraction.

sentences.zh: 又有月行九道遲疾，曆有三大二小者；

translations.literal: Further, the moon's motion along the nine paths has slow and fast phases, and the calendar may show three long and two short months;
translations.idiomatic: Further, the moon's nine-path motion has slow and fast phases, and the calendar may show three long and two short months.

sentences.zh: 依盈縮累增損之，則有四大三小，理數然也。

translations.literal: If one accumulates increase and decrease according to surplus and contraction, there can be four long and three short—this is how the numbers work out.
translations.idiomatic: If one accumulates adjustments by surplus and contraction, four long and three short months can appear—such is the arithmetic.

sentences.zh: 若俯循常儀，當察加時早晚，隨其所近而進退之，使不過三大二小。

translations.literal: If one merely follows the ordinary rule, one should inspect whether the added time is early or late and advance or retreat toward the nearer case, so as not to exceed three long and two short.
translations.idiomatic: If one merely follows ordinary practice, inspect whether the time of occurrence is early or late and advance or retreat toward the nearer case, keeping within three long and two short months.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時日度：置定朔、弦、望約分，副之，以乘其日升降分，一萬約之，所得，升加降減其副，以加其日夜半日度，命如前，各得定朔、弦、望加時日躔黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: To seek the solar degree at the added time of fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon: set the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon reduced remainders aside; multiply by that day's ascension-descension parts, reduce by 10,000; what is obtained—ascension adds, descension subtracts from the duplicate; add to that day's midnight solar degree; name as before; each yields the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added-time solar motion along the Yellow Path lodge degree and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar degree at the true new moon, quarter, and full moon times of occurrence: set each reduced remainder aside, multiply by that day's ascension-descension parts and reduce by 10,000; ascension adds and descension subtracts from the duplicate; add to that day's midnight solar degree and name as before to obtain each true time-of-occurrence solar position on the ecliptic in lodge degrees and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求月行九道：凡合朔初交，冬入陰曆，夏入陽曆，月行青道。

translations.literal: To seek the moon's motion along the nine paths: whenever at conjunction it is the initial crossing—in winter entering the yin sequence, in summer the yang sequence—the moon runs the green path.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's nine-path motion: at the initial crossing of conjunction, when winter enters the yin sequence and summer the yang sequence, the moon runs the green path.

sentences.zh: 冬至、夏至後，青道半交在春分之宿，出黃道東；

translations.literal: After winter solstice and summer solstice, the green path's half-crossing lies at the spring-equinox lodges, emerging east of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After winter and summer solstice, the green path's half-crossing stands at the spring-equinox lodges, east of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立冬、立夏後，青道半交在立春之宿，出黃道東南：至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Spring lodges, emerging southeast of the Yellow Path: at the opposite lodges it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Spring lodges, southeast of the ecliptic; the same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 冬入陽曆，夏入陰曆，月行白道。

translations.literal: In winter entering the yang sequence, in summer the yin sequence—the moon runs the white path.
translations.idiomatic: When winter enters the yang sequence and summer the yin sequence, the moon runs the white path.

sentences.zh: 冬至、夏至後，白道半交在秋分之宿，出黃道西；

translations.literal: After winter solstice and summer solstice, the white path's half-crossing lies at the autumn-equinox lodges, emerging west of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After winter and summer solstice, the white path's half-crossing stands at the autumn-equinox lodges, west of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立冬、立夏後，白道半交在立秋之宿，出黃道西北；

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Autumn lodges, emerging northwest of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Autumn lodges, northwest of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: At the opposite lodges it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 春入陽曆，秋入陰曆，月行朱道。

translations.literal: In spring entering the yang sequence, in autumn the yin sequence—the moon runs the vermillion path.
translations.idiomatic: When spring enters the yang sequence and autumn the yin sequence, the moon runs the vermillion path.

sentences.zh: 春分、秋分後，朱道半交在夏至之宿，出黃道南；

translations.literal: After spring equinox and autumn equinox, the vermillion path's half-crossing lies at the summer-solstice lodges, emerging south of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring and autumn equinoxes, the vermillion path's half-crossing stands at the summer-solstice lodges, south of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立夏、立秋後，朱道半交在立夏之宿，出黃道西南：至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: After Start of Summer and Start of Autumn, the vermillion path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Summer lodges, emerging southwest of the Yellow Path: at the opposite lodges it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Summer and Start of Autumn, the vermillion path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Summer lodges, southwest of the ecliptic; the same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 春入陰曆，秋入陽曆，月行黑道。

translations.literal: In spring entering the yin sequence, in autumn the yang sequence—the moon runs the black path.
translations.idiomatic: When spring enters the yin sequence and autumn the yang sequence, the moon runs the black path.

sentences.zh: 春分、秋分後，黑道半交在冬至之宿，出黃道北；

translations.literal: After spring equinox and autumn equinox, the black path's half-crossing lies at the winter-solstice lodges, emerging north of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring and autumn equinoxes, the black path's half-crossing stands at the winter-solstice lodges, north of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立春、立秋後，黑道半交在立冬之宿，出黃道東北：至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Winter lodges, emerging northeast of the Yellow Path: at the opposite lodges it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path's half-crossing lies at the Start-of-Winter lodges, northeast of the ecliptic; the same holds at the opposite lodges.

sentences.zh: 四序離為八節，至陰陽之所交，皆與黃道相會，故月行有九道。

translations.literal: The four seasons divide into eight nodes; where yin and yang cross they all meet the Yellow Path—hence the moon has nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons divide into eight nodes; where yin and yang meet they all intersect the ecliptic—hence the moon's motion comprises nine paths.

sentences.zh: 各視月行所入正交積度，滿交象去之，入交積度及交象度，並在交會術中。

translations.literal: For each, regard the accumulated degrees of the moon's motion entering the true crossing; when they fill the crossing image, remove them—the entry-crossing accumulated degrees and crossing-image degrees are both in the crossing-meeting procedures.
translations.idiomatic: For each case observe the accumulated degrees of the moon's entry into the true crossing; cast out full crossing images; entry-crossing accumulation and crossing-image degrees are both treated in the conjunction procedures.

sentences.zh: 若在半交象已下為初限；

translations.literal: If at or below the half-crossing image, it is the opening limit;
translations.idiomatic: At or below the half-crossing image is the opening limit.

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減交象，餘為末限。

translations.literal: If above, invert-subtract from the crossing image; the remainder is the closing limit.
translations.idiomatic: Above that, invert-subtract from the crossing image; the remainder is the closing limit.

sentences.zh: 置初、末限度及分，三之，為限分；

translations.literal: Set the opening and closing limit degrees and parts, treble them for limit parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the opening and closing limit degrees and parts, treble them for limit parts.

sentences.zh: 用減四百，餘以限分乘之，二萬四千而一為度，命曰月道與黃道差數。

translations.literal: Subtract from 400; multiply the remainder by the limit parts, as one part of 24,000 for degrees—name it the difference number between the lunar path and the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 400; multiply the remainder by the limit parts and divide by 24,000 for degrees—this is the lunar-path and ecliptic difference number.

sentences.zh: 距正交後、半交前，以差數加；

translations.literal: From the true crossing onward to before the half-crossing, add the difference number;
translations.idiomatic: From after the true crossing to before the half-crossing, add the difference number.

sentences.zh: 距半交後、正交前，以差數減。

translations.literal: From after the half-crossing to before the true crossing, subtract the difference number.
translations.idiomatic: From after the half-crossing to before the true crossing, subtract the difference number.

sentences.zh: 此加減出入黃道六度，單與黃道相校之數，若校赤道，則隨氣遷變不常。

translations.literal: This addition and subtraction in and out of the Yellow Path is six degrees—the number compared with the Yellow Path alone; compared with the equator it shifts with the qi and is not constant.
translations.idiomatic: This addition and subtraction in and out of the ecliptic totals six degrees—the figure compared with the ecliptic alone; compared with the equator it shifts with the solar terms and is not constant.

sentences.zh: 仍計去冬、夏二至已來度數，乘差數，如九十而一，為月道與赤道差數。

translations.literal: Still compute the degrees elapsed since the preceding winter and summer solstices, multiply by the difference number, as one part of 90, for the difference number between the lunar path and the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Still compute the degrees elapsed since the preceding winter and summer solstices, multiply by the difference number, and divide by 90 for the lunar-path and equator difference number.

sentences.zh: 凡日以赤道內為陰，外為陽；

translations.literal: In general the sun takes what is inside the equator as yin, outside as yang;
translations.idiomatic: In general the sun treats what lies inside the equator as yin and outside as yang.

sentences.zh: 月以黃道內為陰，外為陽。

translations.literal: The moon takes what is inside the Yellow Path as yin, outside as yang.
translations.idiomatic: The moon treats what lies inside the ecliptic as yin and outside as yang.

sentences.zh: 故月行宿度，入春分交後行陰曆，秋分交後行陽曆，皆為同名；

translations.literal: Therefore when the moon's lodge degrees enter after the spring-equinox crossing and run the yin sequence, and after the autumn-equinox crossing run the yang sequence, both are same-name;
translations.idiomatic: Hence when the moon's lodge motion after the spring-equinox crossing runs the yin sequence, and after the autumn-equinox crossing runs the yang sequence, both are same-name.

sentences.zh: 入春分交後行陽曆，秋分交後行陰曆，皆為異名。

translations.literal: After the spring-equinox crossing running the yang sequence, and after the autumn-equinox crossing the yin sequence, both are different-name.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring-equinox crossing running the yang sequence, and after the autumn-equinox crossing the yin sequence, both are different-name.

sentences.zh: 其在同名者，以差數加者加之，減者減之；

translations.literal: When same-name, where the difference number adds, add; where it subtracts, subtract;
translations.idiomatic: When same-name, add where the difference adds and subtract where it subtracts.

sentences.zh: 其在異名者，以差數加者減之，減者加之。

translations.literal: When different-name, where the difference number adds, subtract; where it subtracts, add.
translations.idiomatic: When different-name, subtract where the difference adds and add where it subtracts.

sentences.zh: 二差皆增益黃道宿積度，為九道宿積度；

translations.literal: Both differences together augment the Yellow Path lodge accumulated degrees to become nine-path lodge accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Both differences together augment the ecliptic lodge accumulated degrees to become nine-path lodge accumulated degrees.

sentences.zh: 以前宿九道積度減之，為其宿九道度及分秒。

translations.literal: Subtract the previous lodge's nine-path accumulated degrees to obtain that lodge's nine-path degree and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the previous lodge's nine-path accumulation to obtain that lodge's nine-path degree and parts-seconds.

sentences.zh: 其分就近約之為太、半、少。

translations.literal: The parts are rounded nearby to great, half, and small.
translations.idiomatic: Round the parts nearby to great, half, and small.

sentences.zh: 求月行九道平交入氣：各以其月閏日及餘，加經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒，盈交終日及餘秒去之，乃減交終日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek the mean-crossing entry into qi for the moon's nine paths: for each add that month's intercalary day and remainder to the mean new moon added-time generalized entry-crossing day and remainder-seconds; cast out what fills the crossing-terminus day and remainder-seconds; then subtract the crossing-terminus day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean-crossing entry into qi for the nine paths: for each month add that month's intercalary day and remainder to the mean-new-moon generalized entry-crossing day and remainder-seconds; cast out full crossing-terminus days and remainder-seconds, then subtract the crossing terminus.

sentences.zh: 即各得平交入其月中氣日及餘秒；

translations.literal: Each yields the mean-crossing entry into that month's mid-qi day and remainder-seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Each yields mean-crossing entry into that month's mid-term day and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 若滿氣策即去之，余為平交入後月節氣日及餘秒。

translations.literal: If it fills the qi stride, remove it; the remainder is the mean-crossing entry into the following month's solar node day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: If it fills the qi stride, remove it; the remainder is mean-crossing entry into the following month's solar node.

sentences.zh: 若求朏朒定數，如求朔、望朏朒術入之，即得所求。

translations.literal: To seek the waxing-waning fixed number, enter by the procedure for seeking waxing-waning at mean new moon and full moon, and you obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true waxing-waning number, apply the mean-new-moon and full-moon waxing-waning procedure to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 求平交入轉朏朒定數：置所入氣餘，加其日夜半入轉餘，乘其日算外損益率，如統法而一，所得，以損益其下朏朒積，乃以交率乘之，交數而一，為定數。

translations.literal: To seek the mean-crossing entry into rotation waxing-waning fixed number: set the entered qi remainder, add that day's midnight entry-into-rotation remainder, multiply by that day's decrease-increase rate beyond the count, as one part of the era divisor; what is obtained decreases or increases the waxing-waning accumulation below; then multiply by the crossing rate, as one part of the crossing number, for the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean-crossing rotation waxing-waning fixed number: set the entered qi remainder, add that day's midnight rotation remainder, multiply by that day's correction rate beyond the count and divide by the era divisor; adjust the phase accumulation below, then multiply by the crossing rate and divide by the crossing number.

sentences.zh: 求正交入氣：以平交入氣、入轉朏朒定數，朏減朒加平交入氣余，滿若不足，進退其日，即正交入氣日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek true-crossing entry into qi: use the mean-crossing entry into qi and entry-into-rotation waxing-waning fixed number—subtract waxing and add waning from the mean-crossing entry into qi remainder; on fullness or shortfall advance or retreat the day—that is the true-crossing entry into qi day and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find true-crossing entry into qi: apply the mean-crossing entry and rotation waxing-waning fixed number—subtract waxing and add waning from the mean-crossing qi remainder; advance or retreat the day on fullness or shortfall.

sentences.zh: 求正交加時黃道日度：置正交入氣餘，副之，以乘其日升降分，一萬約之，升加降減其副，乃以一百乘之，如統法而一，以加其日夜半日度，即正交加時黃道日度及分秒。

translations.literal: To seek the Yellow Path solar degree at the true-crossing added time: set the true-crossing entry into qi remainder aside; multiply by that day's ascension-descension parts, reduce by 10,000; ascension adds, descension subtracts from the duplicate; then multiply by 100, as one part of the era divisor, and add to that day's midnight solar degree—that is the true-crossing added-time Yellow Path solar degree and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic solar degree at the true-crossing time of occurrence: set the true-crossing qi remainder aside, multiply by that day's ascension-descension parts and reduce by 10,000; ascension adds and descension subtracts; multiply by 100, divide by the era divisor, and add to that day's midnight solar degree.

sentences.zh: 求正交加時月離九道宿度：置正交度加時黃道日及分，三之，為限分。

translations.literal: To seek the moon's departure from the nine-path lodges at the true-crossing added time: set the true-crossing degree added-time Yellow Path day and parts, treble for limit parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's nine-path lodge at the true-crossing time of occurrence: set the true-crossing added-time ecliptic solar day and parts, treble for limit parts.

sentences.zh: 用減四百，餘以限分乘之，二萬四千而一，命曰月道與黃道差數。

translations.literal: Subtract from 400; multiply the remainder by the limit parts, as one part of 24,000—name it the difference number between the lunar path and the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 400; multiply the remainder by the limit parts and divide by 24,000—this is the lunar-path and ecliptic difference number.

sentences.zh: 以加黃道宿度，仍計去冬、夏二至已來度數，以乘差數，如九十而一，為月道與赤道差數。

translations.literal: Add to the Yellow Path lodge degree; still compute the degrees elapsed since the preceding winter and summer solstices; multiply by the difference number, as one part of 90, for the difference number between the lunar path and the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the ecliptic lodge degree; still compute degrees elapsed since the preceding winter and summer solstices, multiply by the difference number, and divide by 90 for the lunar-path and equator difference.

sentences.zh: 同名以加，異名以減，二差皆增損正交度，即正交加時月離九道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Same-name adds, different-name subtracts; both differences together augment or diminish the true-crossing degree—that is the moon's departure from the nine-path lodges at the true-crossing added time, with degree and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Same-name adds and different-name subtracts; both differences adjust the true-crossing degree to yield the moon's nine-path lodge at the true-crossing time of occurrence.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時月離黃道宿度：置定朔、弦、望加時日躔黃道宿度及分，凡合朔加時，月行潛在日下，與太陽同度，是為加時月度。

translations.literal: To seek the moon's departure from the Yellow Path lodges at the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added time: set the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added-time solar motion along the Yellow Path lodge degree and parts; whenever at conjunction the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree—that is the added-time lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's ecliptic lodge at the true new moon, quarter, and full moon times of occurrence: set each solar ecliptic position; at conjunction the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree—that is the time-of-occurrence lunar degree.

sentences.zh: 各以弦、望度加其所當日度，滿黃道宿次去之，即各得定朔、弦、望加時月離黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: For each, add the quarter or full moon arc to the solar degree for that day; when it fills the Yellow Path lodge sequence, remove it—each yields the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added-time moon departure from Yellow Path lodge degrees and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For each, add the quarter or full-moon arc to the solar degree for that day and remove by ecliptic lodge sequence to obtain each true time-of-occurrence lunar ecliptic position.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時月離九道宿度：置定朔、弦、望加時月離黃道宿度及分秒，加前宿正交後黃道積度，如前求九道術入之，以前定宿正交後九道積度減之，餘為定朔、弦、望加時月離九道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: To seek the moon's departure from the nine-path lodges at the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added time: set the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added-time moon departure from Yellow Path lodge degrees and parts-seconds; add the Yellow Path accumulated degrees after the true crossing for the preceding lodge; enter by the nine-path procedure as before; subtract the preceding fixed lodge's nine-path accumulated degrees after the true crossing; the remainder is the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon added-time moon departure from nine-path lodge degrees and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's nine-path lodge at the true new moon, quarter, and full moon times of occurrence: set each true ecliptic lunar position, add the ecliptic accumulation after the true crossing for the preceding lodge, apply the nine-path procedure as before, and subtract the preceding fixed lodge's nine-path accumulation.

sentences.zh: 凡合朔加時，若非正交，即日在黃道、月在九道所入宿度。

translations.literal: Whenever at conjunction, if it is not a true crossing, the sun is on the Yellow Path and the moon on the nine paths, at the lodges entered.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction, if it is not a true crossing, the sun lies on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths at the lodges entered.

sentences.zh: 雖多少不同，考其去極，若應繩准，故曰加時九道。

translations.literal: When their distance from the pole is examined, if it matches like a plumb line and square, hence it is called added-time nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: Though the figures differ, when their distance from the pole is tested they align like plumb line and square—hence the name time-of-occurrence nine paths.

sentences.zh: 求定朔午中入轉：各視經朔夜半入轉日及餘秒，以半法加之，若定朔及餘有進退者，亦進退轉日，否則因經為定。

translations.literal: To seek fixed new moon noon entry into rotation: for each view the mean new moon midnight entry-into-rotation day and remainder-seconds; add the half-divisor; if the fixed new moon day and remainder advance or retreat, also advance or retreat the rotation day; otherwise follow the mean as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: To find true-new-moon noon entry into rotation: for each month take the mean-new-moon midnight rotation entry and add the half-divisor; if the true new moon advances or retreats, adjust the rotation day likewise; otherwise follow the mean.

sentences.zh: 因求次日，累加一日，滿轉周日及餘秒去之，即每日午中入轉。

translations.literal: Then to seek the following day, add one day cumulatively; when it fills rotation circuit days and remainder-seconds, remove it—that is each day's noon entry into rotation.
translations.idiomatic: For the following days add one day cumulatively; cast out full rotation-circuit days and remainder-seconds for each day's noon entry into rotation.

sentences.zh: 求晨昏月度：以晨分乘其日算外轉定分，如統法而一，為晨轉分；

translations.literal: To seek dawn and dusk lunar degrees: multiply the dawn fraction by that day's rotation fixed parts beyond the count, as one part of the era divisor, for dawn rotation parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find dawn and dusk lunar degrees: multiply the dawn fraction by that day's rotation fixed parts beyond the count and divide by the era divisor for dawn rotation parts.

sentences.zh: 用減轉定分，餘為昏轉分；

translations.literal: Subtract from the rotation fixed parts; the remainder is dusk rotation parts;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the rotation fixed parts; the remainder is dusk rotation parts.

sentences.zh: 乃以朔、弦、望小餘乘其日算外轉定分，如統法而一，為加時分；

translations.literal: Then multiply the mean new moon, quarter, and full moon lesser remainder by that day's rotation fixed parts beyond the count, as one part of the era divisor, for added-time parts;
translations.idiomatic: Then multiply the mean new moon, quarter, or full moon minor remainder by that day's rotation fixed parts beyond the count and divide by the era divisor for time-of-occurrence parts.

sentences.zh: 以減晨昏轉分，餘為前；

translations.literal: Subtract from the dawn-dusk rotation parts; the remainder is before;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the dawn-dusk rotation parts; the remainder is before.

sentences.zh: 不足減者，覆減之，餘為後；

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, invert-subtract; the remainder is after;
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient to subtract, invert-subtract; the remainder is after.

sentences.zh: 以前加後減定朔、弦、望月度，即晨、昏月所在度。

translations.literal: Add before and subtract after from the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon lunar degree—that is the degrees where the dawn and dusk moon stand.
translations.idiomatic: Add before and subtract after from the true new moon, quarter, and full moon lunar degree to obtain the dawn and dusk lunar positions.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望晨昏定程：各以其朔昏定月減上弦昏定月，餘為朔後昏定程；

translations.literal: To seek the fixed dawn-dusk intervals for mean new moon, quarter, and full moon: for each take that month's new moon dusk fixed moon minus the first-quarter dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after new moon to dusk;
translations.idiomatic: To find the true dawn-dusk intervals for new moon, quarter, and full moon: subtract the first-quarter dusk moon from that month's new-moon dusk moon for the post-new-moon dusk interval.

sentences.zh: 以上弦昏定月減望昏定月，餘為上弦後昏定程；

translations.literal: Take the first-quarter dusk fixed moon minus the full moon dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after first quarter to dusk;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the full-moon dusk moon from the first-quarter dusk moon for the post-first-quarter dusk interval.

sentences.zh: 以望晨定月減下弦晨定月，餘為望後晨定程；

translations.literal: Take the full moon dawn fixed moon minus the last-quarter dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after full moon to dawn;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the last-quarter dawn moon from the full-moon dawn moon for the post-full-moon dawn interval.

sentences.zh: 以下弦晨定月減後朔晨定月，餘為下弦後晨定程。

translations.literal: Take the last-quarter dawn fixed moon minus the following new moon dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed interval after last quarter to dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the following new moon's dawn moon from the last-quarter dawn moon for the post-last-quarter dawn interval.

sentences.zh: 求每日轉定度數：累計每程相距日轉定分，以減定程，餘為盈；

translations.literal: To seek the daily rotation fixed degrees: cumulatively tally the daily rotation fixed parts over the days of each interval; subtract from the fixed interval; the remainder is surplus;
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily rotation fixed degrees: cumulatively tally the daily rotation fixed parts across the interval days and subtract from the fixed interval; the remainder is surplus.

sentences.zh: 不足減者，覆減之，餘為縮；

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, invert-subtract; the remainder is contraction;
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient to subtract, invert-subtract; the remainder is contraction.

sentences.zh: 以相距日除之，所得，盈加縮減每日轉定分，為每日轉定度及分秒。

translations.literal: Divide by the number of intervening days; what is obtained—surplus adds, contraction subtracts from the daily rotation fixed parts—for the daily rotation fixed degree and parts-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the intervening days; surplus adds and contraction subtracts from the daily rotation fixed parts to obtain the daily rotation fixed degree and parts-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨昏月：置朔、弦、望晨昏月，以每日轉定度及分加之，滿宿次去之，為每日晨昏月。

translations.literal: To seek the daily dawn and dusk moon: set the new moon, quarter, and full moon dawn and dusk moon; add the daily rotation fixed degree and parts; when it fills the lodge sequence, remove it—for the daily dawn and dusk moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily dawn and dusk moon: set each new moon, quarter, and full moon dawn and dusk position, add the daily rotation fixed degree and parts, and remove by lodge sequence.

sentences.zh: 凡注曆，自朔日注昏月，望後一日注晨月。

translations.literal: When annotating the calendar, from the new moon day annotate the dusk moon; from the day after full moon annotate the dawn moon.
translations.idiomatic: When publishing the calendar, annotate the dusk moon from the new-moon day and the dawn moon from the day after full moon.

sentences.zh: 已前月度並依九道所推，以究算術之精微，如求速要，即依後術求之。

translations.literal: All lunar degrees before this are deduced by the nine paths, to probe the subtlety of the arithmetic; if a quick approximation is needed, seek it by the later procedures.
translations.idiomatic: All lunar positions above are derived by the nine paths to probe the arithmetic in full; for a quick approximation, use the later procedures.

sentences.zh: 求天正十一月經朔加時平行月：置歲周，以天正閏餘減之，餘以統法約之為度，不滿，退除為分秒，即天正十一月經朔加時平行月積度及分秒。

translations.literal: To seek the parallel moon at the added time of the eleventh month's mean new moon of heaven's standard: set the year circuit, subtract the heaven's-standard intercalation remainder, reduce the remainder by the era divisor for degrees, what does not fill is reduced for parts-seconds—that is the accumulated parallel-moon degree and parts-seconds at the added time of the eleventh month's mean new moon of heaven's standard.
translations.idiomatic: To find the parallel-moon position at the civil-year eleventh month's mean-new-moon time of occurrence: set the year circuit, subtract the civil-year intercalation remainder, and reduce the remainder by the era divisor for degrees, with the unfilled portion as parts and seconds, yielding the accumulated parallel-moon degree and parts-seconds at that mean new moon's time of occurrence.

sentences.zh: 求天正十一月定朔夜半平行月：置天正經朔小余，以平行月度分秒乘之，如統法而一為度，不滿，退除為分秒，以減天正十一月經朔加時平行月積度，即天正十一月經朔晨前夜半平行月。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed new moon midnight parallel moon of the eleventh month: set the heaven's-standard mean new moon minor remainder, multiply by the parallel moon's monthly degree parts-seconds, as one part of the era divisor for degrees, what does not fill is reduced for parts-seconds; subtract from the accumulated parallel moon at the added time of the eleventh month's mean new moon—that is the parallel moon before dawn at midnight on the mean new moon of the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true-new-moon midnight parallel moon for the eleventh month: set the civil-year mean-new-moon minor remainder, multiply by the parallel moon's monthly degree parts and seconds, divide by the era divisor for degrees, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and subtract from the mean-new-moon time-of-occurrence accumulated parallel moon to obtain the predawn midnight parallel moon on the mean new moon.

sentences.zh: 其定朔大餘有進退者，亦進退平行度，否則因經為定，即天正十一月定朔晨前夜半平行月積度及分秒。

translations.literal: If the fixed new moon greater remainder advances or retreats, also advance or retreat the parallel degree; otherwise follow the mean as fixed—that is the accumulated parallel-moon degree and parts-seconds before dawn at midnight on the fixed new moon of the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: If the true new moon's major remainder advances or retreats, adjust the parallel degree likewise; otherwise follow the mean as fixed, yielding the accumulated parallel-moon degree and parts-seconds before dawn at midnight on the true new moon.

sentences.zh: 求次定朔夜半平行月：置天正十一月定朔晨前夜半平行月積度及分秒，大月加三十五度八十分、秒六十一，小月加二十二度四十三分、秒七十三半，滿周天度及約分、秒去之，即得次定朔晨前夜半平行月積度及分秒。

translations.literal: To seek the next fixed new moon midnight parallel moon: set the accumulated parallel moon degree and parts-seconds before dawn at midnight on the fixed new moon of the eleventh month; for a long month add 35 degrees 80 minutes 61 seconds, for a short month add 22 degrees 43 minutes 73 seconds and a half; when it fills the circuit-of-heaven degree and reduced minutes-seconds, remove it—that yields the next fixed new moon's accumulated parallel moon before dawn at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next true new moon's midnight parallel moon: set the eleventh month's predawn midnight accumulated parallel moon, add 35° 80′ 61″ for a long month or 22° 43′ 73.5″ for a short month, and cast out full circuit-of-heaven degrees and reduced parts to obtain the next true new moon's predawn midnight accumulated parallel moon.

sentences.zh: 求弦望定日夜半平行月：各計朔、弦、望相距之日，乘平行度及分秒，以加其月定朔晨前夜半平行月積度及分秒，即其月弦望定日晨前夜半平行月積度及分秒。

translations.literal: To seek the quarter and full moon fixed-day midnight parallel moon: for each tally the days from new moon to quarter and full moon, multiply the parallel degree and parts-seconds, add to that month's fixed new moon accumulated parallel moon before dawn at midnight—that is that month's quarter and full moon fixed-day accumulated parallel moon before dawn at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: To find the quarter- and full-moon true-day midnight parallel moon: for each month count the days from new moon to quarter or full moon, multiply the parallel degree and parts-seconds, and add to that month's true-new-moon predawn midnight accumulated parallel moon to obtain the quarter or full moon's predawn midnight accumulated parallel moon.

sentences.zh: 求定朔晨前夜半入轉：置其月經朔晨前夜半入轉日及餘秒，若定朔大餘有進退者，亦進退轉日，否則因經為定，其餘如統法退除為分秒，即得其月定朔晨前夜半入轉日及分秒。

translations.literal: To seek fixed new moon entry into rotation before dawn at midnight: set that month's mean new moon entry-into-rotation day and remainder-seconds before dawn at midnight; if the fixed new moon greater remainder advances or retreats, also advance or retreat the rotation day; otherwise follow the mean as fixed; the remainder is reduced by the era divisor for parts-seconds—that is that month's fixed new moon entry-into-rotation day and parts-seconds before dawn at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: To find true-new-moon predawn midnight entry into rotation: set that month's mean-new-moon predawn midnight rotation entry day and remainder-seconds; if the true new moon's major remainder advances or retreats, adjust the rotation day likewise; otherwise follow the mean; reduce the remainder by the era divisor for parts and seconds to obtain that month's true-new-moon predawn midnight rotation entry.

sentences.zh: 因求次日，累加一日，滿轉週二十七日五十五分、秒四十六去之，即每日晨前夜半入轉。

translations.literal: Then to seek the following day, add one day cumulatively; when it fills the rotation circuit of 27 days 55 minutes 46 seconds, remove it—that is each day's entry into rotation before dawn at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: For the following days add one day cumulatively, cast out full rotation-circuit days of 27 days 55 minutes 46 seconds, and obtain each day's predawn midnight entry into rotation.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望晨前夜半定月：置定朔、弦、望晨前夜半入轉分，乘其日算外增減差，百約為分，分滿百為度，增減其下遲疾度，為遲疾定度；

translations.literal: To seek the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon fixed moon before dawn at midnight: set the entry-into-rotation parts before dawn at midnight on the fixed new moon, quarter, or full moon; multiply that day's decrease-increase difference beyond the count; reduce by 100 for parts, when parts fill 100 for degrees; decrease or increase the slow-fast degree below for the slow-fast fixed degree;
translations.idiomatic: To find the true new moon, quarter, and full moon predawn midnight fixed moon: set the predawn midnight rotation-entry parts, multiply that day's correction rate beyond the count, scale by 100 for parts and by 100 parts for degrees, and apply to the slow-fast degree below to obtain the slow-fast fixed degree;

sentences.zh: 遲減疾加定朔、弦、望晨前夜半平行月積度及分秒，以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即各得定朔、弦、望晨前夜半月離宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Slow subtracts, fast adds to the accumulated parallel moon degree and parts-seconds before dawn at midnight on the fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon; add the ecliptic solar degree at the added time of the winter solstice of heaven's standard and name it—that is each fixed new moon, quarter, and full moon lunar lodge departure degree and parts-seconds before dawn at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract slow and add fast to each true new moon, quarter, and full moon predawn midnight accumulated parallel moon, add the civil-year winter-solstice time-of-occurrence ecliptic solar degree, and name the lodges to obtain each true conjunction's predawn midnight lunar lodge departure in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 如求每日晨、昏月，依前術入之，即得所求。

translations.literal: To seek the dawn and dusk moon for each day, enter by the prior procedure, and what is sought is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the dawn and dusk moon for each day, apply the preceding procedure and obtain the result sought.

sentences.zh: 步晷漏

translations.literal: Procedures for gnomon shadow and clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Procedures for Gnomon Shadow and Clepsydra

sentences.zh: 二至限：一百八十二日六十二分。

translations.literal: Solstice limit: 182 days, 62 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Solstice limit: 182 days, 62 parts

sentences.zh: 一象：九十一日三十一分。

translations.literal: One quadrant: 91 days, 31 parts.
translations.idiomatic: One quadrant: 91 days, 31 parts

sentences.zh: 消息法：九千七百三。

translations.literal: Message divisor: 9,703.
translations.idiomatic: Message divisor: 9,703

sentences.zh: 半法：六千一十五。

translations.literal: Half-divisor: 6,015.
translations.idiomatic: Half-divisor: 6,015

sentences.zh: 辰法：二十五。

translations.literal: Double-hour divisor: 25.
translations.idiomatic: Double-hour divisor: 25

sentences.zh: 半辰法：一十二半。

translations.literal: Half double-hour divisor: 12 and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Half double-hour divisor: 12.5

sentences.zh: 刻法：一千二百二。

translations.literal: Clepsydra graduation divisor: 1,202.
translations.idiomatic: Clepsydra graduation divisor: 1,202

sentences.zh: 辰刻：八、餘四百一。

translations.literal: Double-hour graduations: 8, remainder 401.
translations.idiomatic: Double-hour graduations: 8, remainder 401

sentences.zh: 昏明分：三百太。

translations.literal: Dusk-dawn parts: 300 major.
translations.idiomatic: Dusk-dawn parts: 300 and three-quarters

sentences.zh: 昏明刻：二、餘六百一半。

translations.literal: Dusk-dawn graduations: 2, remainder 601 and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Dusk-dawn graduations: 2, remainder 601.5

sentences.zh: 冬至嶽台晷影常數：一丈二尺八寸五分。

translations.literal: Winter-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant: 1 zhang 2 chi 8 cun 5 fen.
translations.idiomatic: Winter-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant: 1 zhang 2 chi 8 cun 5 fen

sentences.zh: 夏至嶽台晷影常數：一尺五寸七分。

translations.literal: Summer-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant: 1 chi 5 cun 7 fen.
translations.idiomatic: Summer-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant: 1 chi 5 cun 7 fen

sentences.zh: 冬至後初限夏至後末限：四十五日、六十二分。

translations.literal: Opening limit after winter solstice and closing limit after summer solstice: 45 days, 62 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Opening limit after winter solstice and closing limit after summer solstice: 45 days, 62 parts

sentences.zh: 冬至後末限夏至後初限：一百三十七日、空分。

translations.literal: Closing limit after winter solstice and opening limit after summer solstice: 137 days, null parts.
translations.idiomatic: Closing limit after winter solstice and opening limit after summer solstice: 137 days, zero parts

sentences.zh: 求嶽台晷影入二至後日數：計入二至以來日數，以二至約分減之，乃加半日之分五十，即入二至後來午中日數及分。

translations.literal: To seek the days after a solstice for Yue Terrace gnomon shadow entry: tally the days since entering a solstice, subtract the solstice reduced parts, then add half-day parts of fifty—that is the noon day-count and parts after entering a solstice.
translations.idiomatic: To find the post-solstice day-count for Yue Terrace gnomon shadow: tally days since a solstice, subtract the solstice fractional parts, add fifty half-day parts, and obtain the noon day-count and parts after entering a solstice.

sentences.zh: 求嶽台午中晷影定數：置入二至後日及分，如初限已下者為初；

translations.literal: To seek the fixed noon gnomon shadow at Yue Terrace: set the day and parts after a solstice; if at the opening limit or below, it is opening;
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed noon gnomon shadow at Yue Terrace: set the post-solstice day and parts; days within the opening limit count as opening;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減二至限，餘為末。

translations.literal: if above, invert-subtract from the solstice limit; the remainder is closing.
translations.idiomatic: days above that, invert-subtract from the solstice limit; the remainder is closing.

sentences.zh: 其在冬至後初限、夏至後末限者，以入限日入分減一千九百三十七半，為泛差。

translations.literal: For those in the opening limit after winter solstice and closing limit after summer solstice, subtract the entry-limit day and entry parts from 1,937 and a half for the provisional difference.
translations.idiomatic: Within the post-winter-solstice opening limit and post-summer-solstice closing limit, subtract the entry-limit day and parts from 1,937.5 for the provisional difference.

sentences.zh: 仍以入限日及分乘其日盈縮積，其盈縮積者，以入盈縮限日及分與二百相減相乘，為盈縮積也。

translations.literal: Again multiply the surplus-contraction accumulation by the entry-limit day and parts; the surplus-contraction accumulation is obtained by subtracting and multiplying the entry into the surplus-contraction limit day and parts with 200.
translations.idiomatic: Then multiply by that day's equation accumulation, which is obtained by subtracting the entry into the equation limit from 200 and multiplying by the entry-limit day and parts.

sentences.zh: 五因百約，用減泛差，為定差；

translations.literal: Multiply by five and reduce by 100; use to subtract from the provisional difference for the fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by five and scale by 100, subtract from the provisional difference, and obtain the fixed difference;

sentences.zh: 乃以入限日及分自相乘，以定差乘之，滿一百萬為尺，不滿為寸、分，以減冬至嶽台晷影常數，餘為其日午中晷影定數。

translations.literal: Then self-multiply the entry-limit day and parts, multiply by the fixed difference; when it fills 1,000,000, that is chi; what does not fill is cun and fen; subtract from the winter-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant; the remainder is that day's noon gnomon-shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Square the entry-limit day and parts, multiply by the fixed difference, take full millions as chi and the remainder as cun and fen, subtract from the winter-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant, and the remainder is that day's fixed noon gnomon shadow.

sentences.zh: 其在冬至後末限、夏至後初限者，以三約入限日及分，減四百八十五少，為泛差；

translations.literal: For those in the closing limit after winter solstice and opening limit after summer solstice, divide the entry-limit day and parts by three, subtract from 485 minor, for the provisional difference;
translations.idiomatic: Within the post-winter-solstice closing limit and post-summer-solstice opening limit, divide the entry-limit day and parts by three, subtract from 485 and a minor quarter for the provisional difference;

sentences.zh: 仍以盈縮差度減去極度，余者春分後、秋分前，四約，以加泛差，為定差。

translations.literal: Again subtract the surplus-contraction difference degree from the pole degree; the remainder: after spring equinox and before autumn equinox, quarter it and add to the provisional difference for the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the equation difference from the polar degree; for the remainder after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox, quarter it and add to the provisional difference to obtain the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 春分前、秋分後，以去二分日數乘之，六百而一，以減泛差，為定差。

translations.literal: Before spring equinox and after autumn equinox, multiply the days from the two divisions by that and divide by 600 to subtract from the provisional difference for the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, multiply the days from the equinoxes, divide by 600, subtract from the provisional difference, and obtain the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 乃以入限日及分自相乘，以定差乘之，滿一百萬為尺，不滿為寸分，以加夏至嶽台晷影常數，為其日午中晷影定數。

translations.literal: Then self-multiply the entry-limit day and parts, multiply by the fixed difference; when it fills 1,000,000, that is chi; what does not fill is cun and fen; add to the summer-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant for that day's noon gnomon-shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Square the entry-limit day and parts, multiply by the fixed difference, take full millions as chi and the remainder as cun and fen, add to the summer-solstice Yue Terrace gnomon-shadow constant, and obtain that day's fixed noon gnomon shadow.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中定積日：置其日午中入二至後來日數及分，以其日盈縮分盈加縮減之，即每日午中定積日及分。

translations.literal: To seek each day's noon fixed accumulated day: set that day's noon count of days and parts since entering a solstice, add or subtract that day's surplus-contraction parts—surplus adds, contraction subtracts—that is each day's noon fixed accumulated day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's fixed accumulated day at noon: set that day's noon post-solstice day-count and parts, add equation parts for surplus and subtract for contraction, and obtain each day's fixed accumulated day and parts at noon.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中消息定數：置定積日及分，在一象已下自相乘，已上，用減二至限，餘亦自相乘，七因，進二位元，以消息法除之，為消息常數；

translations.literal: To seek each day's noon message fixed number: set the fixed accumulated day and parts; if at one quadrant or below, self-multiply; if above, subtract from the solstice limit and self-multiply the remainder too; multiply by seven, advance two place-units, divide by the message divisor for the message constant;
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's fixed noon message number: set the fixed accumulated day and parts; if within one quadrant, square it; if above, subtract from the solstice limit and square the remainder; multiply by seven, advance two places, divide by the message divisor, and obtain the message constant;

sentences.zh: 副置之，用減六百一半，餘以乘其副，以二千六百七十除之，以加常數，為消息定數。

translations.literal: Set aside a duplicate; subtract 601 and a half from it; multiply the duplicate by the remainder; divide by 2,670; add to the constant for the message fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Set aside a duplicate, subtract 601.5, multiply the duplicate by the remainder, divide by 2,670, add to the constant, and obtain the fixed message number.

sentences.zh: 冬至後為息，夏至後為消。

translations.literal: After winter solstice is wax; after summer solstice is wane.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice is wax; after the summer solstice is wane.

sentences.zh: 求每日黃道去極度：置其日消息定數，十六乘之，滿四百一除之為度，不滿，退除為分，春分後加六十七度三十一分，秋分後減一百一十五度三十一分，即每日午中黃道去極度及分。

translations.literal: To seek each day's ecliptic polar distance: set that day's fixed ebb-and-flow number, multiply by sixteen, when it fills 401 divide for degrees, what does not fill is reduced for parts; after spring equinox add 67 degrees 31 minutes, after autumn equinox subtract 115 degrees 31 minutes—that is each day's noon ecliptic polar distance and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's ecliptic polar distance: set that day's fixed ebb-and-flow number, multiply by sixteen, divide by 401 for degrees with the remainder as parts, add 67° 31′ after the spring equinox or subtract 115° 31′ after the autumn equinox, and obtain each day's noon ecliptic polar distance and parts.

sentences.zh: 求每日太陽去赤道內外度：置其日黃道去極度及分，與一象度相減，餘為太陽去赤道內、外度及分。

translations.literal: To seek each day's Sun's distance north or south of the equator: set that day's ecliptic polar distance and parts; subtract from one-quadrant degree; the remainder is the Sun's distance north or south of the equator and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's solar declination: set that day's ecliptic polar distance and parts, subtract from one-quadrant degree, and obtain the Sun's distance north or south of the equator in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 去極多為日在赤道外，去極少為日在赤道內。

translations.literal: Greater polar distance means the Sun is outside the equator; lesser polar distance means the Sun is inside the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Greater polar distance means the Sun is south of the equator; lesser polar distance means the Sun is north of the equator.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨昏分及日出入分半晝分。

translations.literal: To seek each day's dawn-dusk parts and sunrise-sunset parts and half-day parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's dawn and dusk parts, sunrise and sunset parts, and half-day parts.

sentences.zh: 置其日消息定數，春分後加二千一百少，秋分後減三千三百八少，各為其日晨分；

translations.literal: Set that day's message fixed number; after spring equinox add 2,100 minor; after autumn equinox subtract 3,308 minor; each is that day's dawn part;
translations.idiomatic: Set that day's fixed message number, add 2,100 and a minor quarter after the spring equinox or subtract 3,308 and a minor quarter after the autumn equinox, and obtain that day's dawn part;

sentences.zh: 用減統法，餘為昏分。

translations.literal: Subtract from the era divisor; the remainder is dusk part.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the era divisor; the remainder is the dusk part.

sentences.zh: 以昏明分加晨分，為日出分；

translations.literal: Add dawn part to dusk-dawn parts for sunrise part;
translations.idiomatic: Add the dawn part to the dusk-dawn parts to obtain the sunrise part;

sentences.zh: 減昏分，為日入分；

translations.literal: Subtract from dusk part for sunset part;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the dusk part to obtain the sunset part;

sentences.zh: 以日出分減半法，餘為半晝分。

translations.literal: Subtract sunrise part from half-divisor; the remainder is half-day part.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the sunrise part from the half-divisor; the remainder is the half-day part.

sentences.zh: 求每日距中度：置其日晨分，進位，十四因之，以四千六百一十一除之為度，不滿，退除為分，即距子度。

translations.literal: To seek each day's mid-heaven distance: set that day's dawn part, advance one place, multiply by fourteen, divide by 4,611 for degrees, what does not fill is reduced for parts—that is the distance from zi.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's mid-heaven distance: set that day's dawn part, advance one place, multiply by fourteen, divide by 4,611 for degrees with the remainder as parts, and obtain the distance from zi.

sentences.zh: 用減半周天，餘為距中度；

translations.literal: Subtract from half the circuit of heaven; the remainder is mid-heaven distance;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from half the circuit of heaven; the remainder is the mid-heaven distance;

sentences.zh: 五而一，為每更差數。

translations.literal: Divide by five for one to obtain each watch difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by five to obtain each watch's difference.

sentences.zh: 求每日夜半定漏：置晨分，進一位，如刻法而一為刻，不滿為刻分，即每日夜半定漏。

translations.literal: To seek each day's midnight fixed clepsydra: set dawn part, advance one place, as one part of clepsydra graduation divisor for graduations; what does not fill is graduation parts—that is each day's midnight fixed clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's fixed midnight clepsydra: set the dawn part, advance one place, divide by the clepsydra graduation divisor for graduations with the remainder as graduation parts, and obtain each day's fixed midnight clepsydra.

sentences.zh: 求每日晝夜刻及日出入辰刻：置夜半定漏，倍之，加五刻，為夜刻。

translations.literal: To seek each day's day-night graduations and sunrise-sunset double-hour graduations: set midnight fixed clepsydra, double it, add five graduations for night graduations.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's day and night clepsydra graduations and sunrise-sunset double-hour graduations: set the fixed midnight clepsydra, double it, and add five graduations for night graduations.

sentences.zh: 減百刻，為晝刻。

translations.literal: Subtract from 100 graduations for day graduations.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 100 graduations to obtain day graduations.

sentences.zh: 以昏明刻加夜半定漏，命子正，算外，得日出辰刻。

translations.literal: Add dusk-dawn graduations to midnight fixed clepsydra, name from zi midnight, outside the count—that is sunrise double-hour graduations.
translations.idiomatic: Add the dusk-dawn graduations to the fixed midnight clepsydra, count from zi midnight, and outside the count obtain the sunrise double-hour graduations.

sentences.zh: 以晝刻加之，命如前，即日入辰刻。

translations.literal: Add day graduations and name as before—that is sunset double-hour graduations.
translations.idiomatic: Add the day graduations and name as before to obtain the sunset double-hour graduations.

sentences.zh: 其辰數依發斂術求之。

translations.literal: The double-hour count is sought by the issuing-and-gathering procedure.
translations.idiomatic: The double-hour count is derived by the issuing-and-gathering procedure.

sentences.zh: 求更點辰刻：置其日夜半定漏，倍之，二十五而一為籌差；

translations.literal: To seek watch-point double-hour graduations: set that day's midnight fixed clepsydra, double it, divide by twenty-five for one for tally difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find watch-point double-hour graduations: set that day's fixed midnight clepsydra, double it, and divide by twenty-five to obtain the tally difference;

sentences.zh: 半之，進位，為更差。

translations.literal: Halve it, advance one place, for watch difference.
translations.idiomatic: Halve it, advance one place, and obtain the watch difference.

sentences.zh: 以昏明刻加日入辰刻，即甲夜辰刻；

translations.literal: Add dusk-dawn graduations to sunset double-hour graduations—that is the first night watch double-hour graduations;
translations.idiomatic: Add the dusk-dawn graduations to the sunset double-hour graduations to obtain the first night watch's double-hour graduations;

sentences.zh: 以更籌差累加之，滿辰刻及分去之，各得每更籌所在辰刻及分。

translations.literal: Add watch tally difference cumulatively; when it fills double-hour graduations and parts remove—that is each watch tally's double-hour graduations and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add the watch tally difference cumulatively, cast out full double-hour graduations and parts, and obtain each watch tally's double-hour graduations and parts.

sentences.zh: 若用司辰漏者，倍夜半定漏，減去待旦十刻，餘依術算，即得內中更籌也。

translations.literal: If using the Office-of-Time clepsydra, double midnight fixed clepsydra, subtract the ten graduations awaiting dawn, remainder by the procedure—that is the inner watch tallies.
translations.idiomatic: If using the Office-of-Time clepsydra, double the fixed midnight clepsydra, subtract the ten graduations awaiting dawn, and compute by the procedure to obtain the inner watch tallies.

sentences.zh: 求每日昏曉中星及五更中星：置距中度，以其日昏後夜半赤道日度加而命之，即得其日昏中星所格宿次，命之曰初更中星。

translations.literal: To seek each day's dusk, dawn, and five-watch midnight stars: set mid-heaven distance, add that day's post-dusk midnight equatorial solar degree and name it—that is that day's dusk midnight star's lodged lodge; naming it yields the first-watch midnight star.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's dusk, dawn, and five-watch midnight stars: set the mid-heaven distance, add that day's post-dusk midnight equatorial solar degree and name the lodges to obtain the dusk midnight star's lodge, which is named as the first-watch midnight star.

sentences.zh: 以每更差度加而命之，即乙夜中星。

translations.literal: Add each watch difference degree and name it—that is the second night watch midnight star.
translations.idiomatic: Add each watch's difference in degrees and name the lodges to obtain the second night watch's midnight star.

sentences.zh: 以更差度累加之，去命如前，即五更及曉中星。

translations.literal: Add watch difference degree cumulatively, cast out and name as before—that is the five watches and dawn midnight stars.
translations.idiomatic: Add the watch difference cumulatively, cast out and name as before, and obtain the five watches and dawn midnight stars.

sentences.zh: 若依司辰星漏倍距子度，減去待旦三十六度五十二分半，餘依術求更點差度，即內中昏曉五更及攢點中星也。

translations.literal: If following the Office-of-Time star clepsydra, double the distance from zi, subtract awaiting-dawn thirty-six degrees fifty-two minutes and a half, remainder by the procedure for watch-point difference degrees—that is the inner dusk, dawn, five watches, and gathered-point midnight stars.
translations.idiomatic: If following the Office-of-Time star clepsydra, double the distance from zi, subtract thirty-six degrees fifty-two minutes and a half awaiting dawn, derive the watch-point difference by the procedure, and obtain the inner dusk, dawn, five watches, and gathered-point midnight stars.

sentences.zh: 求九服距差日：各於所在立表候之，若地在嶽臺北，測冬至後與嶽台冬至晷影同者，累冬至後至其日，為距差日。

translations.literal: To seek the nine regions' distance-difference day: at each location erect a gnomon table and observe; if the place is north of Yue Terrace and after winter solstice the gnomon shadow matches Yue Terrace's winter-solstice shadow, accumulate from after winter solstice to that day for the distance-difference day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the nine regions' distance-difference day: at each location erect a gnomon table and observe; if the place lies north of Yue Terrace and after the winter solstice its noon shadow matches Yue Terrace's winter-solstice shadow, accumulate the days from the winter solstice to that day as the distance-difference day.

sentences.zh: 若地在岳台南，測夏至後與嶽台晷影同者，累夏至後至其日，為距差日。

translations.literal: If south of Yue Terrace, after summer solstice when the gnomon shadow matches Yue Terrace's, accumulate from after summer solstice to that day for the distance-difference day.
translations.idiomatic: If the place lies south of Yue Terrace and after the summer solstice its noon shadow matches Yue Terrace's, accumulate the days from the summer solstice to that day as the distance-difference day.

sentences.zh: 求九服晷影：若地在嶽臺北冬至前後者，以冬至前後日數減距差日，為餘日。

translations.literal: To seek nine regions' gnomon shadows: if north of Yue Terrace before and after winter solstice, subtract distance-difference day from days before and after winter solstice for remainder days.
translations.idiomatic: To find gnomon shadows for the nine regions: if north of Yue Terrace around the winter solstice, subtract the distance-difference day from the winter-solstice day-count to obtain the remainder days.

sentences.zh: 以餘日減一千九百三十七半，為泛差。

translations.literal: Subtract remainder days from 1,937 and a half for the provisional difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the remainder days from 1,937.5 for the provisional difference.

sentences.zh: 依前術求之，以加嶽台冬至晷影常數，為其地其日午中晷影定數。

translations.literal: Seek by the prior procedure, add to Yue Terrace winter-solstice gnomon-shadow constant for that place and day's noon gnomon-shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the preceding procedure and add to the Yue Terrace winter-solstice gnomon-shadow constant to obtain that place and day's fixed noon gnomon shadow.

sentences.zh: 冬至前後日多於距差日者，乃減去距差日，餘依法求之，即得其地其日午中晷影定數。

translations.literal: If days before and after winter solstice exceed distance-difference day, subtract distance-difference day; seek by the method for that place and day's noon gnomon-shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: If the winter-solstice day-count exceeds the distance-difference day, subtract the distance-difference day and compute by the method to obtain that place and day's fixed noon gnomon shadow.

sentences.zh: 若地在岳台南夏至前後者，以夏至前後日數減距差日，為餘日。

translations.literal: If south of Yue Terrace before and after summer solstice, subtract distance-difference day from days before and after summer solstice for remainder days.
translations.idiomatic: If south of Yue Terrace around the summer solstice, subtract the distance-difference day from the summer-solstice day-count to obtain the remainder days.

sentences.zh: 乃三約之，以減四百八十五少，為泛差。

translations.literal: Then divide by three, subtract from 485 minor, for the provisional difference.
translations.idiomatic: Then divide by three and subtract from 485 and a minor quarter for the provisional difference.

sentences.zh: 依前術求之，以減嶽台夏至晷影常數，即其地其日午中晷影定數。

translations.literal: Seek by the prior procedure, subtract from Yue Terrace summer-solstice gnomon-shadow constant for that place and day's noon gnomon-shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the preceding procedure and subtract from the Yue Terrace summer-solstice gnomon-shadow constant to obtain that place and day's fixed noon gnomon shadow.

sentences.zh: 如夏至前後日數多於距差日，乃減去距差日，餘依法求之，即得其地其日午中晷影定數，即晷在表南也。

translations.literal: If summer-solstice days before and after exceed distance-difference day, subtract distance-difference day; seek by the method for that place and day's noon gnomon-shadow fixed number—the gnomon is then south of the table.
translations.idiomatic: If the summer-solstice day-count exceeds the distance-difference day, subtract the distance-difference day and compute by the method to obtain that place and day's fixed noon gnomon shadow, with the shadow falling south of the table.

sentences.zh: 求九服所在晝夜漏刻：各於所在下水漏，以定二至夜刻，乃相減，餘為二至差刻。

translations.literal: To seek day-night clepsydra graduations at each nine-region location: at each location drain the clepsydra below, set the fixed two-solstice night graduations, subtract—the remainder is the two-solstice difference graduations.
translations.idiomatic: To find day and night clepsydra graduations for each of the nine regions: at each location run the clepsydra below, fix the two-solstice night graduations, subtract them, and the remainder is the two-solstice difference in graduations.

sentences.zh: 乃置嶽台其日消息定數，以其處二至差刻乘之，如嶽台二至差刻二十除之，所得為其地其日消息定數。

translations.literal: Set Yue Terrace's message fixed number for that day; multiply by that place's two-solstice difference graduations; as Yue Terrace's two-solstice difference graduations of twenty divide it—what is obtained is that place and day's message fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Set Yue Terrace's message fixed number for that day, multiply by that place's two-solstice difference graduations, divide by Yue Terrace's two-solstice difference of twenty graduations, and obtain that place and day's message fixed number.

sentences.zh: 乃倍消息定數，進位元，滿刻法約之為刻，不滿為分，以加減其處二至夜刻，春分後、秋分前，以加夏至夜刻；

translations.literal: Then double the fixed ebb-and-flow number, advance the place-unit, when it fills clepsydra graduation divisor reduce for graduations; what does not fill is parts; add or subtract that place's two-solstice night graduations—after spring equinox and before autumn equinox add to summer-solstice night graduations;
translations.idiomatic: Then double the fixed ebb-and-flow number, advance one place, reduce by the clepsydra graduation divisor for graduations with the remainder as parts, and add or subtract that place's two-solstice night graduations—after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox add to the summer-solstice night graduations;

sentences.zh: 秋分後、春分前，以減冬至夜刻。

translations.literal: After autumn equinox and before spring equinox subtract from winter-solstice night graduations.
translations.idiomatic: After the autumn equinox and before the spring equinox subtract from the winter-solstice night graduations.

sentences.zh: 為其地其日夜刻；

translations.literal: That is that place and day's night graduations;
translations.idiomatic: That yields that place and day's night graduations;

sentences.zh: 以減百刻，餘為晝刻。

translations.literal: Subtract from 100 graduations; the remainder is day graduations.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 100 graduations; the remainder is the day graduations.

sentences.zh: 求日出入差刻及五更中星，並依嶽台法求之。

translations.literal: To seek sunrise-sunset difference graduations and five-watch midnight stars, all seek by the Yue Terrace method.
translations.idiomatic: To find sunrise-sunset difference graduations and five-watch midnight stars, apply the Yue Terrace method throughout.
